capturedBy: ARES-1 handoff (read-only public explorer; NOT the exporter --capture-fixture smoke)
method: Human-readable public explorer (explorer.solana.com) read of a finalized devnet transaction; payload base64 decoded offline with the committed IDL event-only snapshot.

tokenTransfer.note: SKR (pinned constant SKR_MINT in lib.rs:159); 500 SKR matches the owner-confirmed export-license price in game/docs/API.md.

notes: Real devnet beta transaction; public chain data. Devnet test wallets only, no mainnet players, no PII, no credentials.
cost_skr_atoms is SKR atoms (6 decimals): the explorer shows the same 500.000000 SKR transfer.
This is the only currently un-ambiguous purchase rail visible on chain as a single event; PresalePurchase.amount is currency-neutral and must be resolved from the emitting instruction.
